name: Jonathan Metcalf

bio.statement: Metcalf's pamphlet statement lists work in construction and service as a U.S. Marine Corps combat veteran with two deployments to Afghanistan.
bio.excerpt: Construction; United States Marine Corps combat veteran; two deployments to Afghanistan

bio.statement: Metcalf's pamphlet statement lists service as an Estacada city councilor since 2023 and as council president.
bio.excerpt: Estacada City Councilor, 2023-present; Council President; Economic Development Commission Liaison

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Metcalf says that as mayor he would pursue funding for roads, utilities and essential services.
positions.excerpt: As mayor, I will focus on practical solutions: pursuing funding for roads, utilities, and essential services;

positions.statement: Metcalf's pamphlet statement says the community deserves a mayor who listens, communicates clearly and brings people together around shared goals.
positions.excerpt: Our community deserves a mayor who listens, communicates clearly, and brings people together around shared goals.

positions.statement: Metcalf's pamphlet statement says he will approach decisions with discipline and respect for taxpayers.
positions.excerpt: I will approach each decision with discipline, common sense, and respect for taxpayers.
